## Reuse verified real products

These examples read a completed real case. They never generate raster values or
response labels. Set `CAST_REAL_CASE` explicitly before running them.

```{r case}
library(castSDM)
case_dir <- Sys.getenv("CAST_REAL_CASE")
run <- readRDS(file.path(case_dir, "training", "result.rds"))
comparison <- readRDS(file.path(case_dir, "comparison", "comparison.rds"))
comparison$contract
comparison$runtime
run$cv$timings
run$cv$engine_fits
```

## Sampling and missingness

The case default declares 10,000 background points. The background count is an
input policy, not a universal SDM optimum. Occurrence and background records are
subject to the declared study domain and environmental coverage.

The default complete-case policy preserves eligible indicators and reports record
loss. Strict `drop_predictors` instead preserves sampled sites and drops any
incomplete indicator before splitting. A few missing cells can exclude many
indicators, so this policy is opt-in. Neither policy fills in measurements.
`predictor_missing_qc.csv` records per-indicator missingness; validation is
conditional on study-input QC and the occurrence-informed domain.

## Environmental responses

A driver-only contrast changes that fitted factor against current background.
A retained contrast restores it against the actual future background. Sign
reversal diagnoses background dependence; it does not identify a causal effect.
Individual contrasts need not add to the complete scenario change.

Marginal training-quantile support, MESS and multivariate AOA are different
checks. Marginal support does not establish joint support. Engine disagreement
is not a sampling confidence interval. Maps keep unsupported locations explicit.

## Frozen scientific policies

Out-of-fold predictions determine thresholds and ensemble weights. Hold-out
labels evaluate that fixed policy; do not tune it on those labels. Fold metrics
using the pooled OOF threshold describe a training-side operating point.
Predictive scores concern sampled presence/background labels, not verified
absence data or calibrated occupancy probabilities.

`cast_run(cache_dir=...)` verifies stage identities; changed predictor selection,
model policy or inputs require a new scientific analysis. Outputs from old
versions are never relabelled as a new analysis. Raster batches can resume when
models, inputs, mask and settings match; source input files remain read only.

## Interface and exports

```{r app}
cast_app(case_dir)
```

Shiny opens existing products without refitting. Complete native rasters, PNG/PDF
figures, settings, source tables and a reproducible view bundle remain available.
Interactive previews are display grids; clicked values come from native grids.
